title: What is the current stable release date / version?
body: There doesn’t seem to be any note of current release date / version or release note to document what changes are made in the new version.

comments.body:
Seems like you need to just find the best [nightly](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases ) that fits your needs.  The "official" [latest APK](https://xdrip-plus-updates.appspot.com/stable/xdrip-plus-latest.apk) seems just as buggy, but with less features.

However I've yet to find a build that doesn't intermittently "hang" (for lack of better description) the G5 ob1 collector, requiring me to restart my phone and/or restart the collector, then nurse the collector back to life by watching the "G5 Status" screen, keeping the phone from sleeping, waiting for the "Phone Service State" to say"Got data ..." and "Bluetooth Link" to say "Closed OK".  After that, it seems to work again until it intermittently hangs (1 to 3 times a day), missing data from my G5 until I rinse+repeat.  

Really quite annoying.

You can click on commits to see what has been done for each release.  That's all we have.
No, it's not a release note.
![Untitled](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51497406/117747060-7e4f1c00-b1db-11eb-8be5-6b7394973574.png)

It has been requested before.  It will not be added.  I am sorry.
